evidence.quote: If you enroll in a higher professional education program with us, you must pay tuition fees annually.
Meld je aan voor de opleiding via Studielink.

notes: Tuition fee is the institution-wide non-EEA institutional fee for bachelor's students (€10,308 for 2026-2027); the programme page itself does not state a programme-specific fee. Intake start month is September (quote "Startmaand September") but no year or exact date is given, so startDate is null. No language proficiency, subject, or document requirements were stated on the supplied pages for this programme.
